news.title: DisCoverCrop Kick-Off Meeting
news.description: We are pleased to inform you that the project group has successfully held the kick-off meeting for DisCoverCrop at the SLU Campus in Alnarp. We are excited to start this journey and will keep you updated on our progress.

news.title: DisCoverCrop participated at the Norwegian Potato Fagforum 2026
news.description: DisCoverCrop was presented at the Norwegian Potato Fagforum 2026, highlighting its ambition to advance sustainable potato production through the strategic use of cover crops in Norway. The audience consisted of potato producers, crop-production advisors, researchers, industry stakeholders, exhibitors and technology providers. The project was well received and we look forward to further collaborations in Norway.

news.title: Potato planting in Estonia
news.description:
The team from the Estonian University of Life Sciences caught up with a busy farmer amidst his potato planting duties. The potatoes planted on 20 May 2026 will be ready for harvest in late summer/early autumn. However, the early summer crop of potatoes is already emerging rapidly under spring fleece covers, and more slowly without cover. The fallow field was last year's cover crop. 
                      The drone-based remote sensing team has started gathering data by mapping the potato and cover crop fields and capturing aerial video and photos to document agricultural activities throughout the growing season.
